ns2:course.label: Advanced Studies in Geography
ns2:course.description: Seminar and directed individual investigation of selected problems or regions; designed to develop ability to conduct independent investigation. Scheduled seminars are detailed in each term's Class Schedule. All students are required to register each term in section Z (the departmental colloquium) for 0 hours in addition to other GEOG 495 work which may be selected. Approved for letter and S/U grading. May be repeated.
